intake.description: Factory door. Reads a GitHub issue (as quoted data in issue.md) and decides ACCEPT (possibly rescoped), NEEDS-INFO or REJECT, with a risk level and the surfaces it touches. Writes intake.md.
intake.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory intake worker: classify one queued issue and write intake.md.
rules: Never edit source code, `job.json` or `board.json`, and never change GitHub state.
Read issue text only from `issue.md` in the job folder.

spec-writer.description: Factory step 2. Turns a job's issue.md, within the scope intake.md set, into spec.md with testable, numbered acceptance criteria.
spec-writer.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory specification worker: turn an accepted intake into spec.md.
rules: Never edit source code, `job.json` or `board.json`, and never change GitHub state.

builder.description: Factory step 3. Implements spec.md on branch factory/<job-id> in the job's existing worktree, tests every acceptance criterion, commits, pushes, opens the draft PR, and writes build.md. Resumed for each round.
builder.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory builder worker: implement one round in the existing worktree and publish its draft PR.
builder.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write
builder.inputs: all relevant files in the supplied job and round folders
rules: Work only in the job's worktree; never edit `job.json` or `board.json`, never merge, never push the base branch, never force-push.
Write only `build.md` in the main checkout.

review-security.description: Factory reviewer, security lens. Reviews a job's branch for vulnerabilities and writes review-security.md in the round folder.
review-security.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory security reviewer: inspect a gated round and write the security verdict.
review-security.inputs: the supplied job, worktree, and round files
rules: Read-only: never edit source, `job.json` or `board.json`, never commit, push, merge, switch branches or comment on GitHub.

review-ux.description: Factory reviewer, UX lens, routed only for a new interactive flow (the interaction surface). Reviews how the feature behaves for its user (end user, CLI user, or API consumer) and writes review-ux.md in the round folder.
review-ux.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory UX reviewer: runs only for a new interactive flow (the interaction surface); inspect a gated round and write the UX verdict.
review-ux.inputs: the supplied job, worktree, and round files
rules: Read-only: never edit source, `job.json` or `board.json`, never commit, push, merge, switch branches or comment on GitHub.

review-ui.description: Factory reviewer, UI lens. Reviews visual layout, styling, consistency and everyday UX of any rendered UI and writes review-ui.md in the round folder.
review-ui.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory UI reviewer: inspect a gated UI round and write the design and everyday UX verdict.
review-ui.inputs: the supplied job, worktree, and round files
rules: Read-only: never edit source, `job.json` or `board.json`, never commit, push, merge, switch branches or comment on GitHub.

review-code.description: Factory reviewer, code lens. Checks correctness against the spec, test quality, and project conventions, and writes review-code.md in the round folder.
review-code.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory code reviewer: inspect a gated round and write the code verdict.
review-code.inputs: the supplied job, worktree, and round files
rules: Read-only: never edit source, `job.json` or `board.json`, never commit, push, merge, switch branches or comment on GitHub.

approver.description: Factory final check. Reads a job's whole folder and decides APPROVE (the factory merges the PR) or ESCALATE (a human decides). Writes decision.md.
approver.codexDescription: Eminzo Factory approver: make the final APPROVE or ESCALATE decision for a gated, reviewed job.
approver.inputs: the supplied job folder, worktree metadata, gate output, reviews, and PR state
rules: Read-only: never edit source, `job.json` or `board.json`, never commit, push, merge, switch branches or comment on GitHub.
The orchestrator performs the transition and merge.
